newsitem.title: CANADA: Laperriere & Verreault gets China contract.
newsitem.headline: Laperriere & Verreault gets China contract.

text.p: Groupe Laperriere & Verreault Inc said on Monday that it was awarded C$10 million of contracts in Asia.

That included a C$9 million contract awarded to its GL&V/Black Clawson-Kennedy Pulp and Paper Machine Group Inc by the Nine Dragon Paper Industry Co, a pulp and paper mill based in Guangdong Province in the People's Republic of China.

The one-year contract covered the design and manufacture of complete paper machine components. GL&V was also awarded a roughly C$1 million contract to design and manufacture a headbox for a paper mill in South Korea, a mandate obtained through Samyang Heavy Machinery Co.
